subject.title: [Feature]: Ali bailian coding plan support ( thinking/reasoning enabled )

question: Should OpenClaw officially enable Ali Bailian/Qwen Coding Plan reasoning through bundled Qwen catalog entries, custom bailian provider configs, or both?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent support boundary depends on vendor/model proof and on whether maintainers want separate partial PRs or one consolidated provider change.

options.title: Review Verified Slices
options.body: Review the open custom-provider and catalog PRs as separate verified slices, then close this issue only after merged coverage or an explicit documented remainder.

options.title: Request One Consolidated Fix
options.body: Ask contributors to combine bundled catalog, custom-provider inference, docs, and tests into one Qwen-provider PR after vendor verification.

options.title: Defer Broad Enablement
options.body: Keep current behavior and require stronger model-by-model Alibaba proof before changing bundled catalog reasoning flags.

recommendation.title: Review Verified Slices
recommendation.body: Review the open custom-provider and catalog PRs as separate verified slices, then close this issue only after merged coverage or an explicit documented remainder.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced and recently routed the Qwen provider/catalog surface and already gave issue-specific review guidance.
